Augment Item /313
Augment
Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on Equipment items. Once socketed, they can be replaced by other Augments, but cannot be removed by normal means.

The types of Equipment which an Augment can be placed into and the corresponding benefit provided are listed on the item.

Augment
Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on Equipment items. Once socketed, they can be replaced by other Augments, but cannot be removed by normal means.

The types of Equipment which an Augment can be placed into and the corresponding benefit provided are listed on the item.

Idolatry
Ascendancy: Spirit Walker
Character: Huntress
Companions deal 10% increased damage per Idol in your Equipment
-4% to all Elemental Resistances per non-Idol Augment in your Equipment
2% increased Reservation Efficiency of Skills per Idol in your Equipment
Artificer's Orb
Adds an Augment Socket to a Martial Weapon or Armour
Soul Core
Soul Cores are artifacts of the ancient Vaal empire and function as a type of Augment.
Abyssal Eye
Abyssal Eyes are artifacts recovered from Abyssals which function as a type of Augment.
Rune
Runes are Augments of Kalguuran origin and make.
Idol
Idols are a type of Augment fashioned by the Azmeri.
Ancient Augment
These are Augments which have powerful singular effects, but are more limited. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.
Exceptional Item
Exceptional Items have Quality over maximum or an additional Augment Socket.

High Tier Rare Items found have a chance to instead drop as an Exceptional Normal Item.
Socket-bound Augments
Socket-bound Augments permanently fill any Augment Socket they are placed into.

Once Socketed, they cannot be removed, replaced or extracted by any means.
Congealed Mist
A mysterious Augment that shifts and shimmers. Is that whispering you hear?
Aldur's Legacies
Aldur's Legacies are Augments which have taken the power of a Ezomyte Unique or Kalguuran Unique. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.

Community Wiki

Edit

Augment

Augment are items that can be inserted into equipment sockets to grant additional stats, effects, or unique modifiers.

The current types of Augment are:

  • Rune
  • Soul Core
  • Idol
  • Abyssal Eye
  • Congealed Mist
